title: License checker with carousel
request:
License compliance checker. The user lists SPDX license ids separated by commas. Copyleft: GPL-2.0, GPL-3.0, AGPL-3.0, LGPL-2.1, LGPL-3.0, MPL-2.0. Permissive: MIT, BSD-2-Clause, BSD-3-Clause, Apache-2.0, ISC, Unlicense. Reply ' copyleft,

permissive, unknown'. If k > 0 also attach a carousel card with one item per copyleft license (title = license id, subtitle 'copyleft'), each with a button 'Review' whose selection is {"action":"review","license":""}.
